sources.title: Comprehensive inter-comparison of generative AI models for super ...
sources.snippet: This study presents a systematic intercomparison of three representative deep-learning architectures for precipitation super-resolution, namely a Convolutional U-Net as baseline, a conditional Wasserstein GAN (WGAN), and a conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM).
